    Normed bases of basic algebras in characteristic two (given Corollary 10.5) #

    The proof of Proposition 8.3(1) in characteristic two (main-theorems.tex), for a basic representation-finite algebra A: the rows of Proposition 6.1 with their dual mesh weights (residual_dual), the filtered structure of A over A₀ (posFiltA), and the characteristic-two step on A₀ (char2_A0). Corollary 10.5 is a hypothesis here; it is discharged by cor105Hyp in FinalBasis.lean.
